query: Which small‑study bias methods will be primary under differing heterogeneity levels? Define I² or tau² thresholds to switch from PET‑PEESE to selection models or Bayesian selection procedures and diagnostics to report.

response.query: Which small‑study bias methods will be primary under differing heterogeneity levels? Define I² or tau² thresholds to switch from PET‑PEESE to selection models or Bayesian selection procedures and diagnostics to report.
response.answer: Under high heterogeneity, switch from PET-PEESE to selection models at I² > 75% or tau² > 0.01; use Bayesian selection procedures for diagnostics.

results.content: We aim to identify risk-factors, etiology, and outcome of stroke in young patients recruited in the IMPETUS Stroke study. **Results:** This study included 6287(63%) ischemic stroke patients and 3770(37%) with ICH. This study aimed to evaluate the outcomes of edaravone dexborneol in acute ischemic stroke (AIS) patients with large infarction. **Background and Aims:** MR PREDICTS @24H, a nine-predictor model applicable 24h after EVT, demonstrated excellent performance in predicting outcome at 90 days of patients with acute ischemic stroke. **Methods:** This registry-based cohort study included stroke patients admitted to Sahlgrenska University Hospital (2014-2019). **Background and Aims:** For patients with symptomatic carotid stenosis, no study has assessed hour-by-hour timing of stroke recurrences nor provided well-powered day-by-day risk estimates during the first 14 days. **Methods:** A multidisciplinary team comprising all relevant stakeholders developed a national strategy incorporating new scientific evidence to improve stroke prevention, management and treatment, with a comprehensive patient-centered approach that spans all phases of the disease, contributing to better health outcomes and quality of life.
